name: Kruse Rhododendron SNR
description: Kruse Rhododendron State Natural Reserve, next to Salt Point State Park on the Sonoma coast, protects a quiet second-growth redwood and fir forest where pink rhododendrons bloom each spring.
fullDescription: Kruse Rhododendron State Natural Reserve, next to Salt Point State Park on the Sonoma coast, protects a quiet second-growth redwood and fir forest where pink rhododendrons bloom each spring.
whatTheyOffer:
- More than 2 miles of forest hiking trails, including a short loop through the rhododendrons (best bloom in spring)
- Picnic area, parking, and restrooms
- No camping (campgrounds are at neighboring Salt Point State Park)
howToGetIt: No day-use fee is listed. From Jenner, drive about 21 miles north on Highway 1 to Kruse Ranch Road, then about 1 mile east to the entrance. Call 707-847-3221 for hours. Mushroom foraging is not allowed in the reserve.
address: Hwy 1 & Kruse Ranch Rd, Cazadero, CA, 95421
keywords: Kruse Rhododendron, state natural reserve, Cazadero, Sonoma County, flowers, spring, nature, hiking
